$comment: Documented lean-entry dependency exclusions verified from real peer-inclusive esbuild metafiles. includedOptionalPeers removes only those peers from the ordinary external list; forbiddenInputs are normalized metafile path fragments. tool-param-form.js intentionally registers the select and option controls it renders, but not the unused checkbox family. widget-renderer.class.js's `registry` property defaults to the built-in `DEFAULT_WIDGET_TYPE_REGISTRY` (see its own JSDoc), so `default-registry.js` -- a pure data module (tag-name + prop-allowlist literals via createWidgetTypeRegistry(), no component-class imports) -- is a legitimate, cheap, always-bundled input and was removed from this list; the 8 actual widget-type component classes it maps to (card/badge/button/stat/result-card/result-field/markdown/media-card) are populated separately by the side-effectful widget-renderer.ts registration entry, not by default-registry.ts, so those forbiddenInputs entries remain accurate.
